channel.title: Aurora SaaS Changelog
channel.description: Release notes for the Aurora customer operations platform.

item.title: Checkout API adds partial capture controls
item.description: Merchants can now capture split shipments without reopening the order.
item.content:encoded: The February Aurora release adds partial capture controls for the Checkout API. The rollout note includes verification steps for fulfillment, refunds, and payment ledger exports.

item.title: Risk dashboard highlights manual review queues
item.description: New queue cards separate high-value holds from routine fraud checks.
item.content:encoded: Risk operations teams get cards for high-value holds, repeat buyer reviews, and account takeover investigations.

item.title: Quartz lighthouse audit closes accessibility gaps
item.description: The quartz lighthouse audit phrase is included for deterministic search checks.
item.content:encoded: The quartz lighthouse audit fixed keyboard traps in billing setup and improved contrast on the usage timeline.

item.title: Billing webhook retries expose last delivery status
item.description: Each webhook endpoint now shows the latest retry result.
item.content:encoded: Administrators can inspect retry attempts, response codes, and the last successful delivery timestamp.

item.title: Seat limit warnings arrive before renewal
item.description: Workspace owners receive deterministic renewal warnings in-app.
item.content:encoded: Workspace owners see a banner when projected seat usage crosses the renewal threshold.
